# sfcompute_instance_templates (Data Source)

Reads instance templates from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/instance_templates`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ending_before` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the previous page.
- `id` (List of String) Filter by instance template ID or name (repeatable).
- `include` (List of String) Additional fields to include in the response.
- `limit` (Number)
- `starting_after` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the next page.
- `workspace` (String) Scope the returned list to a single workspace (ID, resource path, or name). Without it, the returned list spans every workspace where the caller has `InstanceTemplate:List` and `InstanceTemplate:Read` (granted at either the workspace or organization level). If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String) Pass as `starting_after` or `ending_before` to paginate.
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_init_user_data` (String) Base64-encoded [cloud-init user data](https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/explanation/format/index.html).
- `cloud_init_user_data_used` (Boolean) Whether cloud-init user data is configured for this template.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `enable_public_ipv4` (Boolean) Whether instances started with this template get a public IPv4 address.
- `firewall` (String) Firewall applied to instances started with this template. Present exactly when `enable_public_ipv4` is true.
- `id` (String) Accepts the canonical prefix below; additional legacy prefixes are aliased for read compatibility. Writes always emit the canonical form.
- `image` (Attributes) Machine image to use when starting instances with this template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--image))
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a instance_template resource. Format: sfc:instance_template:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `tags` (Map of String) Metadata tags attached to this instance template. Instances launched from it don't inherit these tags.
- `workspace` (String)
- `workspace_id` (String)

### Nested Schema for `data.image`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Accepts the canonical prefix below; additional legacy prefixes are aliased for read compatibility. Writes always emit the canonical form.
